EmailTemplate.subject: OPRT - Profile Cards
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName}
Thank you for your email. Insperity Organizational Planning offers the ability to create profile cards. Profile cards allow supplemental information to be included in the chart without being directly visible inside the employee box.
You can view our job aid here for assistance with creating a profile header and body. If you have any additional questions or if I can be of further assistance, please let me know.
Thank you,
